name: comp-166
blurb: Pricing tier selector with radio buttons and popular badge.
description: RadioGroup with four pricing tiers (Hobby, Plus, Team, Enterprise). Each tier shows label, price, and Plus tier has a Popular badge. Uses aria-describedby for price descriptions.
use_when: You need to let users select from predefined pricing plans with clear visual hierarchy.
avoid_when: For custom pricing flows; this is for static, predefined plans.
a11y: RadioGroupItem linked to labels. Prices are described via aria-describedby. Full keyboard navigation.
